user_statement: Ik wil het paper en de slides nog niet online, alleen zelf hebben, zal ik de instruxties van stap 3 invoeren?
applies_to: publicly accessible manuscript/slide content and reproducing bundles

observed_existing_exposure.website_products_and_replication_downloa: Previously published and not withdrawn in this preference-registration turn
observed_existing_exposure.git_history: Contains earlier paper and presentation versions; removing links or latest-tree files alone does not remove historical access

step3_first_action: Preserve private copies; withdraw paper and presentation from website, current public packages and public repository surfaces. Assess Git history and caches explicitly; do not claim privacy from link removal alone.
not_authorized_by_this_preference_alone: Changing visibility of the entire repository or disabling the authorized public dashboard
subsequent_publication_requires: A new explicit user decision for paper/slides
deferred36_and_fresh_source_replication: Remain deferred; do not start either run
overrides: Earlier instructions to publish the paper, presentation or an all-product replication ZIP during step 3
